- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:18556-18559 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The comment added in the last run says "the next tick posts the hold notice for a maintainer instead of re-planning (never a second re-plan, never a stuck issue)", but that only holds when the label rollback at lines 18561-18563 succeeds, and it contradicts line 18555 ("If the rollback fails too, the retrigger_plan arm recovers it").
  WHY: Suppose the POST lands but its response is lost, the one-attempt confirmation read (line 18541) fails, and the rollback fails. The issue then stays in `ai:planning`, and the `retrigger_plan` arm (scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:18730-18746) posts a plain `/answer` with no marker check, so a second plan run happens (source severity NIT, mapped to low; minimax_minimax-m3 makes the same inaccuracy claim inside its task-gap entry; anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 review notes judge the comment accurate for the case it describes).
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "A plan held only by non-exact tokens gets exactly one automatic re-plan per issue"; the marker must survive "across ticks and stall-judge choices" (issue Risks: "Loop through other recovery arms. Mitigation: the marker is read from the issue's comments, so it survives across ticks and stall-judge choices.")
  expected_change_site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, the managed and standalone `retrigger_plan` recovery arms (18730-18746, 23381-23395), plus the `ai:planning` recovery ladder in scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:1664-1667, or extend the `_plan_auto_approval_gate` phase gate to also fire from `ai:planning`
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The marker is checked only in `_plan_auto_approval_gate`, which is gated to `ai:awaiting-approval` (scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:18491-18507). The `ai:planning` ladder offers `retrigger_plan` twice (scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:1664-1668). Both poller arms post an unmarked `/answer` without reading `comments_json` for the `ai:automation-path-replan:v1` marker (scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:18730-18740, 23381-23388). In the triple-failure case (POST response lost, confirmation read failed, rollback failed; lines 18556-18563), the issue stays in `ai:planning` with the marker present and a second `/answer` gets posted. After a marked re-plan starts, a stalled planning phase can also trigger another `/answer`. The `::warning::` at 18563 misstates the residual state ("no re-plan marker") when the POST landed. The comment at 18556-18559 is inaccurate. Neither the PR diff nor the last-run diff edits the `retrigger_plan` arm or the ladder. No test covers the triple-failure path plus a next-tick `retrigger_plan`. glm notes the window is narrow and the ladder is bounded. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 disputes this gap in its review notes: the "exactly one" goal covers re-plans triggered by path_not_granted holds, `retrigger_plan` is the existing stalled-planning recovery, and the residual risk was accepted in earlier rounds.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

- TASK_GAP | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  Requirement: A plan held only by non-exact tokens gets exactly one automatic re-plan per issue. The issue also says the marker must survive across ticks and stall-judge choices.
  Expected change site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, the retrigger_plan recovery arm in scripts/orchestrate_lib.py
  Evidence of absence: The marker check is gated to ai:awaiting-approval in _plan_auto_approval_gate, but the ai:planning recovery ladder offers retrigger_plan twice, and its poller arm posts /answer without checking the marker. If the re-plan comment lands but its confirmation read and label rollback fail, the issue can remain in ai:planning, and a later retrigger_plan then posts another /answer despite the marker.

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- TASK_GAP | scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:18556-18559 (LAST RUN DIFF added claim); 18491 (marker check phase gate); 18730-18746 (retrigger_plan arm); scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:1664-1667 (ai:planning recovery ladder) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  Requirement: The issue's "exactly one automatic re-plan per issue" constraint and its mitigation ("the marker is read from the issue's comments, so it survives across ticks and stall-judge choices").
  PROBLEM: The marker check is gated to `ai:awaiting-approval` in `_plan_auto_approval_gate`, but the `retrigger_plan` arm for `ai:planning` posts `/answer` unconditionally without consulting the `ai:automation-path-replan:v1` marker. In the triple-failure case the issue is left in `ai:planning` with the marker present, and the next tick's `retrigger_plan` produces a second re-plan. The comment added at 18556-18559 ("the next tick posts the hold notice for a maintainer instead of re-planning") is inaccurate when the rollback fails.
  WHY: `_plan_auto_approval_gate` no longer runs because its phase gate at line 18491 requires `ai:awaiting-approval`. The stall recovery invokes `retrigger_plan` (scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:1664-1667) without a marker check, and plan.yml re-runs planning. The `::warning::` at line 18563 misstates the residual state ("left in `ai:planning` with no re-plan marker").
  Expected change site: Teach the `retrigger_plan` arm to skip when the trusted `<!-- ai:automation-path-replan:v1 issue=<N> -->` marker is present in `comments_json` (same trusted-comment jq filter), or extend the `_plan_auto_approval_gate` phase gate to fire from `ai:planning`. Also correct the `::warning::` text at 18563.
  Evidence of absence: The PR diff and last-run diff contain no edit to scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:18730-18746 or scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:1664-1667. `test_managed_replannable_hold_lost_comment_response_keeps_planning` and `test_managed_replannable_hold_comment_failure_posts_no_hold_notice` do not cover the triple-failure path.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- TASK_GAP | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  Requirement: "A plan held only by non-exact tokens gets exactly one automatic re-plan per issue"; the marker must survive "across ticks and stall-judge choices."
  Expected change site: `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`, both managed and standalone `retrigger_plan` recovery arms.
  Evidence of absence: The marker is checked only in `_plan_auto_approval_gate` for `ai:awaiting-approval` (`scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:18491-18507`). The `ai:planning` recovery ladder offers `retrigger_plan` twice (`scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:1664-1667`), and both poller arms post an unmarked `/answer` without checking for the marker (`scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:18730-18740`, `23381-23388`). After the marked re-plan starts, a stalled planning phase can therefore trigger another `/answer` despite the marker.

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:lines 18556-18559 (comment added in the last run), interacting with lines 18552-18555 and 18560-18563 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The comment's claim "the next tick posts the hold notice for a maintainer instead of re-planning (never a second re-plan, never a stuck issue)" holds only when the rollback at lines 18561-18563 succeeds. It contradicts line 18555 ("If the rollback fails too, the retrigger_plan arm recovers it"), and the `retrigger_plan` arm (scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:18730-18746) posts `/answer` with no marker check.
  WHY: If the POST lands with its response lost, the confirmation read (line 18541, one attempt) fails, and the rollback fails, the issue stays in `ai:planning`. The `ai:planning` ladder then re-plans via `retrigger_plan`, which contradicts "never a second re-plan".
- TASK_GAP | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  Requirement: "A plan held only by non-exact tokens gets exactly one automatic re-plan per issue" and, from the issue's Risks section: "Loop through other recovery arms. Mitigation: the marker is read from the issue's comments, so it survives across ticks and stall-judge choices."
  Expected change site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, the `retrigger_plan` recovery arm (lines 18730-18746), which should honour the `ai:automation-path-replan:v1` marker.
  Evidence of absence: The marker check exists only inside `_plan_auto_approval_gate`, gated to `ai:awaiting-approval` (lines 18491-18492). `retrigger_plan` posts `/answer` unconditionally (lines 18730-18740), and the `ai:planning` ladder offers it twice (scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:1664-1668). In the residual case at lines 18556-18563, a second `/answer` is posted despite the marker. The window is narrow (three independent single-attempt failures) and the ladder is bounded, but the mitigation is not implemented for this arm.
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
